macros.name: atColsBreak
macros.doc: Adds ⟨tokens⟩ in place of the original column break (made without balancing).

macros.name: atColsEnd
macros.doc: Adds ⟨tokens⟩ at the end of right column.

macros.name: flushcolsend
macros.doc: This macro switches on column balancing on the current page.

macros.name: flushend
macros.doc: This macro switches on column balancing on the last page.

macros.name: raggedcolsend
macros.doc: This macro switches off column balancing on the current page.

macros.name: raggedend
macros.doc: This macro switches off column balancing on the last page.

macros.name: showcolsendrule
macros.doc: It can be used just for debugging: adds rule to the bottom of columns.
